svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.56k stars in total, about 1.92k a year earlier. jactionlint 352, mr boxington 787, aube 2076, fnox 2416, hk 1353, pitchfork 722, usage 1081, +6 more 774.
